# SYNTHETIC citizen-budget fixture for the GENERIC parser test. Fictional
# categories and amounts in the shape of a RS/BiH "Буџет за грађане" — NO real
# municipal data. Exercises: single-column rows, two interleaved side-by-side
# columns on one line, leading ordinals + budget codes, wrapped names, a stated
# grand total, subtotal rows, the fiscal year, and US-format debt figures that
# must NOT be parsed as amounts.
